title: Did the filter pick useful items?
hook: A toy attention filter selects ten items; compare its disclosed relevance mix.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to audit the relevance composition of a chosen set rather than assuming salience equals usefulness

misconception: The most salient selected material necessarily matches the task objective.
objective: Audit the relevance composition of a chosen set rather than assuming salience equals usefulness.
